title: DealsFlow: An Evidence-Gated Agentic Harness for Venture Capital Deal Triage
abstract: arXiv:2610.32380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can read startup pitch decks, but letting them emit investment scores directly invites score inflation, run-to-run variance and rationales that are hard to audit. We describe DealsFlow, a human-in-the-loop agentic harness deployed at a UK early-stage fund. The LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category; code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them. Three mechanisms implement this: a stage-aware corroboration ceiling (78, 70 or 60 out of 100) on factual categories without external evidence; a sceptic call that may lower but never raise a score; and a pre-fetch pattern that retrieves and indexes all evidence before a single generation pass. We evaluate on $N=243$ SEIS/EIS investments with recorded outcomes. Because recent investments have unresolved outcomes, we use the 142 that are at least three years old. There, the full pipeline's score has Spearman $\rho=0.45$ (95% CI 0.32

translated_title: DealsFlow：面向风险投资交易筛选的证据门控智能体框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以阅读初创公司的融资路演材料，但若让它们直接输出投资评分，会导致评分虚高、多次运行结果不一致以及推理依据难以审计等问题。我们介绍了DealsFlow，这是一个在英国一家早期投资基金部署的人机协同智能体框架。LLM负责阅读路演材料、引用证据并对各维度进行评分；代码则负责组合评分、设置上限，且只会下调评分。该框架通过三个机制实现：针对缺乏外部证据佐证的事实类别的分阶段感知佐证上限（满分100分中的78、70或60分）；一个只会降低而绝不会提高评分的“怀疑者”调用机制；以及在单次生成前预先获取并索引全部证据的预取模式。我们在N=243笔有记录结果的SEIS/EIS投资上进行评估。由于近期投资的结果尚未确定，我们选用了其中142笔至少三年以上的投资。在这些投资上，完整流程的评分与结果的Spearman相关系数ρ=0.45（95%置信区间0.32起）。
tldr: DealsFlow是一个部署于英国早期基金的人机协同智能体框架，通过证据门控机制（阶段感知评分上限、怀疑者调用和预取模式）防止LLM投资评分虚高，在142笔三年以上的投资中评分与实际结果的Spearman相关系数达到0.45。
en_tdlr: DealsFlow is a human-in-the-loop agentic harness deployed at a UK early-stage fund that prevents LLM score inflation through evidence-gated mechanisms (stage-aware corroboration ceilings, a sceptic call, and a pre-fetch pattern), achieving Spearman ρ=0.45 correlation with actual outcomes on 142 investments at least three years old.
